subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, and what credential, scope, consent, and subscription contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review can prove the missing capability, but choosing whether OpenClaw should ingest non-mentioned Space content changes data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scopes, and operator consent boundaries.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth or Workspace Events contract, SecretRef/redaction behavior, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhook Model
options.body: Leave the official Google Chat plugin limited to service-account HTTP webhooks and require @mentions for Space messages.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a broader Google Workspace credential and event-subscription model before adding all-message Space ingestion to Google Chat.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth or Workspace Events contract, SecretRef/redaction behavior, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the landed thread-reply history and prior Google Chat auth/security review context.
